title: Scanferno, round 2: one job per screen
question: Every card uses the same organized structure: a left rail of 6 workspaces (Call, Briefing, Plan, Aerial, Mayday, Evac), a slim incident strip on top, and Ask at the bottom. The cards differ in look. Sketches show the Briefing workspace.

options.label: Field Manual
options.lineage: IFSTA-style firefighter training manuals: color-coded chapter tabs, numbered skill sheets
options.thesis: Each workspace is a chapter with its own tab color; every list an officer acts on is a numbered step sheet.
options.viewport: Red wordmark, slim incident strip, color-tabbed workspace rail. Briefing as 4 ruled boxes: Rescue (red plate + numbered steps + mini plan), Entry, Hazards, Exterior.
options.risk: The chapter colors must stay on the rail; repeated across the page they turn into rainbow clutter.

raised.raise: Hierarchy by scale contrast: one large fact per box, small labels.
Inferred data carries a visible INFERRED state instead of being hidden.
A fact that changes holds its highlight until the officer looks at it.
One grid governs every workspace, so compartments line up across screens.
Three type sizes total; one reversed plate (the trapped person) per screen.

options.label: Guide Sign
options.lineage: US highway guide and warning signs, made to be read at speed from a moving vehicle
options.thesis: The three facts that matter are signs you read at a glance from a moving truck; everything else waits below.
options.viewport: Three sign panels across the top (Trapped red, Enter green, Watch yellow), then Search order with plan and Hazards, Ask bar at the bottom.
options.risk: Sign panels become costume if used beyond the top three; big type means less fits per screen.

options.label: Lexicon and Plate
options.lineage: 19th-century reference lexicons: black text column, color only inside bordered plates
options.thesis: The briefing reads as calm prose; color lives only in the plates (floor plan, aerial).
materials: guide words in the head rule
options.viewport: Text column left (Rescue, Entry, Hazards as entries), plates right (plan, aerial), workspace index down the outside margin.
options.case: Wins on calm and organization; loses on audience and on night use in a truck.
options.risk: A light, bookish page glares in a dark cab and reads academic, not fireground.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.viewport: One giant fact fills the screen.
options.case: Loses both: no fireground connection, no room for the plan.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.risk: Low-res type hurts reading at speed.
options.kept: Data quality shown as an honest, visible state.

options.label: Gate Board
options.thesis: Rows rerank in place; changes stay lit.
options.risk: Airline again; you passed on the coupon book.
options.case: Loses on audience, ties on clarity.
options.kept: A changed fact stays lit until noticed.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The grid is visible and governs everything.
options.risk: Grid lines add noise you asked to remove.
options.kept: One shared grid across every workspace.

options.label: Timetable Rack
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight and case.
options.kept: Few type sizes; one reversed plate per screen.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean sidebar app (Linear / Vercel class) in dark slate with one orange accent.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar with workspaces, Briefing as 3 cards and an Ask bar.
canonCard.risk: Organized but anonymous; looks like any SaaS app.
